overall_goal: Add ginger, garlic, and chili to a mortar and crush them into a paste

goals.description: Add ginger and garlic pieces to the mortar
goals.rationale: The person picks up pieces of ginger and cloves of garlic from the chopping board and places them into the mortar.

goals.description: Add chopped chili pieces to the mortar
goals.rationale: The person gathers chopped slices of chili and transfers them one by one into the mortar.

goals.description: Cut and add additional chili to the mortar
goals.rationale: The person prepares more chili by separating, cutting, and discarding the unwanted parts before adding the remaining piece to the mortar.

goals.description: Crush the ingredients in the mortar using a pestle
goals.rationale: The person prepares the mortar and pestle, inspects the pestle, and then crushes the ingredients into a paste.
